name = 'scene3d.planet_orbit', params = {'seed': 4242}
out_dir = PosixPath('/data/soffy/projects/hevi-storybook/.tmp/pytest-of-soffy/pytest-19/test_capability_render_passes_0/cap_render')

    def _render_capability(
        name: str,
        params: dict[str, Any],
        out_dir: str | Path,
        *,
        duration: float,
        aspect: str,
        seed: int,
    ) -> CapabilityResult:
        """Core render callable shared by all scene3d capabilities.
    
        Every failure mode (bad params, unsupported aspect, missing preset, render
        crash, missing/truncated video) surfaces as :class:`CapabilityError` — never
        as a fake success.
        """
        from hevi.layer4_legacy.scene3d.renderer import SceneRenderer
    
        # Validate against the capability's own params schema first.
        cap = get(name)
        cap.validate_params(params)
        # A capability that declares only 16:9/9:16 must refuse 1:1 etc. up front
        # instead of silently rendering an unsupported frame.
        if not cap.supports_aspect(aspect):
            raise CapabilityError(
                f"capability {name} does not support aspect {aspect!r} "
                f"(supported: {cap.aspects})"
            )
        if duration <= 0:
            raise CapabilityError(f"capability {name}: duration must be positive, got {duration}")
        # These are finished preschool animation shots, not arbitrary micro-clips.
        # The minimum makes the visual beat readable and keeps API and ShotSpec
        # capability entry points aligned with the kids line's pacing contract.
        if duration < 2.0:
            raise CapabilityError(
                f"capability {name}: shot duration must be at least 2.0s, got {duration}"
            )
    
        out_dir = Path(out_dir)
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            spec = _build_spec(name, params, duration, aspect, seed)
        except CapabilityError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            raise CapabilityError(f"scene3d failed to build scene: {exc}") from exc
    
        (out_dir / "scene.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(scene_to_dict(spec), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        try:
            r = SceneRenderer(spec, out_dir)
>           metrics = r.render()
                      ^^^^^^^^^^

name = 'scene3d.star_sea', params = {}
out_dir = PosixPath('/data/soffy/projects/hevi-storybook/.tmp/pytest-of-soffy/pytest-19/test_capability_render_determi0/det_a')

    def _render_capability(
        name: str,
        params: dict[str, Any],
        out_dir: str | Path,
        *,
        duration: float,
        aspect: str,
        seed: int,
    ) -> CapabilityResult:
        """Core render callable shared by all scene3d capabilities.
    
        Every failure mode (bad params, unsupported aspect, missing preset, render
        crash, missing/truncated video) surfaces as :class:`CapabilityError` — never
        as a fake success.
        """
        from hevi.layer4_legacy.scene3d.renderer import SceneRenderer
    
        # Validate against the capability's own params schema first.
        cap = get(name)
        cap.validate_params(params)
        # A capability that declares only 16:9/9:16 must refuse 1:1 etc. up front
        # instead of silently rendering an unsupported frame.
        if not cap.supports_aspect(aspect):
            raise CapabilityError(
                f"capability {name} does not support aspect {aspect!r} "
                f"(supported: {cap.aspects})"
            )
        if duration <= 0:
            raise CapabilityError(f"capability {name}: duration must be positive, got {duration}")
        # These are finished preschool animation shots, not arbitrary micro-clips.
        # The minimum makes the visual beat readable and keeps API and ShotSpec
        # capability entry points aligned with the kids line's pacing contract.
        if duration < 2.0:
            raise CapabilityError(
                f"capability {name}: shot duration must be at least 2.0s, got {duration}"
            )
    
        out_dir = Path(out_dir)
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            spec = _build_spec(name, params, duration, aspect, seed)
        except CapabilityError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            raise CapabilityError(f"scene3d failed to build scene: {exc}") from exc
    
        (out_dir / "scene.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(scene_to_dict(spec), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        try:
            r = SceneRenderer(spec, out_dir)
>           metrics = r.render()
                      ^^^^^^^^^^

    def _render_capability(
        name: str,
        params: dict[str, Any],
        out_dir: str | Path,
        *,
        duration: float,
        aspect: str,
        seed: int,
    ) -> CapabilityResult:
        """Core render callable shared by all scene3d capabilities.
    
        Every failure mode (bad params, unsupported aspect, missing preset, render
        crash, missing/truncated video) surfaces as :class:`CapabilityError` — never
        as a fake success.
        """
        from hevi.layer4_legacy.scene3d.renderer import SceneRenderer
    
        # Validate against the capability's own params schema first.
        cap = get(name)
        cap.validate_params(params)
        # A capability that declares only 16:9/9:16 must refuse 1:1 etc. up front
        # instead of silently rendering an unsupported frame.
        if not cap.supports_aspect(aspect):
            raise CapabilityError(
                f"capability {name} does not support aspect {aspect!r} "
                f"(supported: {cap.aspects})"
            )
        if duration <= 0:
            raise CapabilityError(f"capability {name}: duration must be positive, got {duration}")
        # These are finished preschool animation shots, not arbitrary micro-clips.
        # The minimum makes the visual beat readable and keeps API and ShotSpec
        # capability entry points aligned with the kids line's pacing contract.
        if duration < 2.0:
            raise CapabilityError(
                f"capability {name}: shot duration must be at least 2.0s, got {duration}"
            )
    
        out_dir = Path(out_dir)
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            spec = _build_spec(name, params, duration, aspect, seed)
        except CapabilityError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            raise CapabilityError(f"scene3d failed to build scene: {exc}") from exc

asset_id = 'building-03-boulangerie'
source_path = PosixPath('/data/soffy/projects/hevi-storybook/assets/scene3d/source/building-03-boulangerie.glb')
cache_dir = PosixPath('/data/soffy/projects/hevi-storybook/.tmp/pytest-of-soffy/pytest-19/test_optimize_asset_reduces_tr0/cache')

    def optimize_asset(
        asset_id: str,
        source_path: str | Path,
        cache_dir: str | Path,
        *,
        kind: str = "prop",
        ratio: float | None = None,
        texture_target: int = 512,
        repo_root: str | Path | None = None,
    ) -> OptimizeResult:
        """Decimate + downscale one GLB into ``cache_dir`` and measure both ends.
    
        A skinned mesh (``skin_count > 0``) is copied through unchanged: the handbook
        validates decimation on static assets only, and re-rigging a decimated mesh
        is out of scope, so guessing would put an unverified number in the manifest.
        """
        src = Path(source_path)
        src_info = inspect_glb(src)
        ratio = ratio_for_kind(kind) if ratio is None else ratio
    
        cache_dir = Path(cache_dir)
        cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        source_sha = sha256_file(src)
        key = _cache_key(source_sha, ratio, texture_target)
        out = cache_dir / f"{asset_id}-{key}.glb"
    
        skinned = src_info.skin_count > 0
        if out.exists():
            after = inspect_glb(out)
            return OptimizeResult(
                asset_id=asset_id,
                source_path=str(src),
                output_path=str(out),
                ratio=ratio,
                texture_target=texture_target,
                cache_hit=True,
                before=src_info,
                after=after,
                optimized_sha256=sha256_file(out),
            )
    
        binary = find_gltf_transform(repo_root)
        if binary is None:
>           raise OptimizerUnavailable(
                "gltf-transform not found (PATH or repo node_modules); "
                "run `npm install @gltf-transform/cli` in the worktree"
            )
E           hevi.scene3d.assets_pipeline.optimize.OptimizerUnavailable: gltf-transform not found (PATH or repo node_modules); run `npm install @gltf-transform/cli` in the worktree
